hero.lead: AIDEP is an international platform for human development that brings together projects, schools, methodologies and initiatives dedicated to education, inclusion and social transformation.
hero.reach: Operating across the whole of Brazil

about.title: A human development platform built on the ground.
paragraphs: We bring projects, schools, methodologies and initiatives together under a single institutional structure. Sport and parasport are the means; developing people is the goal.
We do not work through isolated actions: every project enters this structure with follow-up, records and accountability.
We operate across the whole of Brazil, and our statute provides for international operation.

projects.title: Three fronts, one purpose.
projects.description: Each project works at a different point in the path of the people we serve: the neighbourhood, the school and knowledge.

approach.title: From the sports hub to the discussion table.
approach.description: The work of AIDEP starts in the community and organises itself all the way up to the institutions that shape the future of sport.

sport.title: Tools, not ends.
paragraphs: For AIDEP, sport and parasport are not the destination. They are the means through which education, inclusion and social transformation happen — in communities, in schools and in spaces of knowledge.
That is why sport and parasport sit side by side in the name of the association: the same structure, the same care and the same technical standard for everyone.

presence.title: Where AIDEP is.
paragraphs: The current work of the association covers the whole Brazilian territory, with projects in communities, schools and spaces of learning.
The statute of AIDEP provides for international operation, and the identity of the association was built with that reach in mind.

items.question: Where does my donation go?
items.answer: To the projects of the association: the Coração Valente Social Project, Futsal na Escola and FutEdu Summit. The funds sustain sports hubs, the presence of sport in schools and the training activities.

items.question: Does AIDEP account for what it receives?
items.answer: Yes. Accountability is prepared every month and published on the Transparency page, together with reports and institutional documents.

items.question: Who is served by the projects?
items.answer: Children, teenagers, young people, adults and communities in situations of vulnerability. More than 40 thousand people have already been reached.

items.question: Where does AIDEP operate?
items.answer: Across the whole Brazilian territory. The statute of the association also provides for international operation.

items.question: How can I donate right now?
